regions: All includes every active cell. Other diagnostic masks overlap and never replace acceptance. Cartesian inferred spacing tiers are not native AMR levels.
angular_method: All actual nodal directions and values retained, grouped by round(r,14) only for diagnostic means/scatter; no projection into evolution or interpolated ray claim.
temporal_limit: Actual native Ketcheson2S RK4 controls compare dt and dt/2. Independent stored spherical profiles use classical RK4; no equivalence assumed at finite dt.
spatial_limit: N6/8/10 Cartesian AND shell logical N change. Penrose volume and puncture minimum radius change; a uniform order inferred from volume RMS would be misleading. No apparent RMS-order fit.
unavailable: CSV contains scalar H/M/Theta/Z diagnostic norms; vector momentum/Z component residual differences and regional original elliptic residuals require derivative-complete data, not reconstructed here.
